d: A VERSIONED INVOCATION COLLIDES WITH VERSIONED SOFTWARE. "Invoke" plus "4.2" pulls INVOKEAI at version 4.2 — documentation, release video, GitHub, a Reddit hardware thread — against two archive cards where the Space Ark is at 4.2.6.
reading: THE VERSION NUMBER IS THE COLLISION, NOT THE WORD. «space ark 4.2.7 invoke 4.2.6 execute trigger» returns InvokeAI, an open-source image-generation tool whose release "Invoke 4.2" matches the query’s version string as well as its verb. Four of six cards are that software: documentation on Python requirements, a release video, a model repo, and a Reddit thread about an 8GB card. The two archive cards carry the invocation as specified — "Space Ark — Scent: 'invoke' — Coordinate: 10.5281/zenodo.19013315 — Mass: The entire architecture. 45,000 words. Load it and the model beco[mes]…" — so the instruction and its collision are in the same frame. A protocol that borrows the vocabulary of software invocation is retrieved as software.
